definitions.gloss: list price, fixed price, regular price
definitions.explanation: The standard or official price set by the manufacturer or seller, before any discounts or sales.

examples.english: The list price of this book is 1,500 yen.

examples.japanese: {定価|ていか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧30⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧⟦{引|び}き→引き：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}っている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: They're selling it at 30% off the regular price.

examples.japanese: {定価|ていか}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.notes: Books in Japan often have fixed prices

notes:
USAGE: {定価|ていか} refers to the standard price printed on products, especially books. In Japan, books typically have a {定価|ていか} that retailers must follow (⟦{再販制度|さいはんせいど}→再販制度：28452_saihanseido⟧ - resale price maintenance system).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定価|ていか}⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (fixed-price sales)
- {定価|ていか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ (to buy at list price)
- {定価|ていか}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (cheaper than list price)
- {定価|ていか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧○%⟦{引|び}き→引き：noentry⟧ (○% off list price)

HOMOPHONE: ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧ (decline, decrease) - different kanji, different meaning.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (retail price)
- ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (manufacturer's suggested retail price)
